# Posting to Slack: resolve the channel, respect exact message wording

Procedure for tasks that require posting a message to Slack.

1. Resolve the channel first: list/search channels and use the exact channel
   name or ID from the task (e.g. `#ops-alerts`), not a guess.
2. If the target is a person (DM), look up their Slack user ID by name/email
   before sending.
3. When the task dictates message content or a template, reproduce it exactly,
   substituting only the dynamic values gathered from earlier steps.
4. For thread replies, pass the parent message's timestamp/thread ID instead of
   posting a new top-level message.
5. Verify the post succeeded from the tool result before reporting done.

I’m ready to enter the bills, update payment terms for any > $10,000, follow AP procedures, and post the summary to Slack — but I don’t yet have the vendor bills or the system details I need to act.

Please provide the following so I can proceed:

1) Source of this week’s vendor bills (pick one or more):
   - A Google Sheet or Excel file (attach or share link). If a sheet, include columns at minimum: Vendor name, Invoice number, Invoice date, Due date, Total amount (preserve verbatim), Currency, Line description(s), Account code (if applicable), and any special handling notes.
   - OR PDF/image files in a shared folder (Google Drive/Dropbox/Box) with the folder link.
   - OR an email folder/label (e.g., Gmail label) or other location where those invoices are stored. If email, identify the account and folder/label.

2) Xero target organization identifier (organization name as it appears in Xero) and confirmation I may:
   - Create a contact in Xero if a vendor is not found.
   - Set vendor payment terms to Net 15 for bills that exceed $10,000.

3) Slack channel name or ID for the AP channel (e.g., #accounts-payable). I will post the exact text including: Bills entered total: $X where X will be the verbatim total amount(s) from the source data combined.

4) Any AP special-handling rules I should apply beyond setting Net 15 for > $10,000 (for example: route to a specific approver, require PO matching, attach original PDF to Xero bill, or flag for tax/1099 review). If you don’t specify, I will follow default AP procedures: create the bill in Xero (attach source PDF when available), change vendor terms to Net 15 if Total amount > 10,000 (verbatim), and add an internal note on the bill for any special-handling text present in the source data.

What I’ll do once you provide the above:
- Enter each bill into Xero (creating contacts if needed).
- For any bill whose Total amount (preserved verbatim from the source) exceeds 10,000, update that vendor’s payment terms to “Net 15.”
- Follow the AP procedures described above (or any you supply).
- Post to the AP Slack channel with the exact line: Bills entered total: $X (X = verbatim sum of the entered bills from source data).
- Report back a short confirmation of each bill entered (vendor + invoice number + total amount verbatim) and the Slack post result.

Provide the bills and the Xero/Slack details and I’ll start entering them.

- Controller
